# LIMIT 1.0.7 verification

This snapshot passed the Android validation workflow: JVM tests, lint, debug APK build and API29 emulator instrumentation including task removal.
Physical Redmi/HyperOS reliability, overnight battery behavior, API34+ runtime behavior and installation as an update to 1.0.6 are not certified.
Debug signing keys are generated per runner. Do not uninstall your personal installation to install this APK. A matching original signing key is required for an in-place update.
